verdict.rationale: Retell's function-calling docs list 'transfer calls' as a built-in agent action alongside ending calls, booking appointments, etc., which supports the general concept of escalating a call to a human. However, the evidence never distinguishes warm vs. blind transfer modes nor describes passing conversational context/metadata to the receiving human agent. missing for 10: explicit warm-transfer vs blind-transfer configuration, evidence of context/data hand-off to the human agent, and any hands-on confirmation of this feature working in practice.
